title: Solving word problems by drawing a picture
examples: How do I solve a word problem?
Do I add or take away in a word problem?
How does drawing help with maths?

explain.say: Some maths problems are short stories. Ana has 5 apples. Her gran gives her 3 more. How many apples does Ana have now? Drawing the story helps you solve it. Look at the board.

draw.text: Solving word problems by drawing a picture

explain.say: Step 1 is to read the story. Step 2 is to draw it. Simple dots are fine. Draw 5 dots for Ana's 5 apples. Can you draw 5 dots?

explain.say: Step 4 is to count your picture. Start at 5 and count on 3: 6, 7, 8. Ana has 8 apples. Look at the ten frame: 5 and 3 make 8.
Now try this one. Kenji has 9 stickers. He gives 4 away. That is fewer, so you take away. Draw 9 dots and cross out 4. 5 dots are left. Today, make up your own maths story with a grown-up.

faq.q: Do I need to draw real apples?
faq.a: No. Dots, circles or lines are fine. The picture helps you see the numbers.

faq.q: How do I know if I add or take away?
faq.a: Ask: is it getting more, or fewer? More, like given or joined, means add. Fewer, like eaten or given away, means take away.

faq.q: What if I cannot read the story?
faq.a: Ask a teacher or grown-up to read it to you. Understanding the story is the important part.
asks: Can someone read the problem to me?

faq.a: A picture turns words into something you can see and count. Then the maths is right there in front of you.

faq.q: How do I check my answer?
faq.a: Count your picture again, and ask: does it make sense in the story? Ana started with 5 and got more, so 8 makes sense.

quiz.say: Ana has 5 apples. She gets 3 more. What do you do?
quiz.show: 🍎 5 apples, then 3 more. What do you do?
quiz.why: Ana gets more apples, so you add.

wrong.1: Take away is for when some things go.
wrong.2: Sharing splits things into equal groups.

quiz.say: Kenji has 9 stickers. He gives 4 away. How many stickers are left?
quiz.show: 9 stickers. 4 given away. How many are left?
quiz.why: He gives some away, so you take away. 9 take away 4 is 5.

wrong.0: 4 is how many stickers Kenji gave away.
